  1. Classes

Class

Geometry

Explore Geometry through bike frames, wheels, berms and jumps. Angles, triangles and circles are in every part of the bike and every feature on the trail.

9 units · 43 topics · 1 learning activity

Units

  1. Unit 1 Foundations of Geometry 4 topics

    1. Points, Lines, and Planes

      Use the undefined terms of geometry and the notation for naming figures.

      • Name points, lines, rays, segments and planes
      • Describe intersections of lines and planes
      • Use basic postulates about points, lines and planes
      Activities in development

    2. Segments and Angles

      Measure and construct segments and angles; use the segment and angle addition postulates.

      • Use the segment addition postulate
      • Measure and classify angles
      • Use the angle addition postulate
      Activities in development

    3. Angle Relationships

      Complementary, supplementary, vertical and linear-pair angles.

      • Use complementary and supplementary angles
      • Use vertical angles
      • Write and solve equations from angle relationships
      Activities in development

    4. Parallel and Perpendicular Lines

      Angles formed by a transversal, and conditions that make lines parallel or perpendicular.

      • Name and use angle pairs formed by a transversal
      • Use angle pairs to show lines are parallel
      • Use properties of perpendicular lines
      Activities in development
  2. Unit 2 Reasoning and Proof 4 topics

    1. Logical Reasoning

      Inductive and deductive reasoning, and counterexamples.

      • Make conjectures by inductive reasoning
      • Disprove a conjecture with a counterexample
      • Draw conclusions by deductive reasoning
      Activities in development

    2. Conditional Statements

      If-then statements, their converse, inverse and contrapositive, and biconditionals.

      • Write statements in if-then form
      • Write converse, inverse and contrapositive
      • Decide whether statements are true
      Activities in development

    3. Geometric Proofs

      Write two-column and paragraph proofs using definitions, postulates and theorems.

      • Use properties of equality and congruence
      • Write two-column proofs
      • Write paragraph proofs
      Activities in development

    4. Congruence Statements

      Write congruence statements and use corresponding parts.

      • Write congruence statements
      • Identify corresponding parts
      • Use CPCTC in proofs
      Activities in development
  3. Unit 3 Triangles 6 topics

    1. Triangle Classification

      Classify triangles by sides and by angles.

      • Classify triangles by sides
      • Classify triangles by angles
      • Use the triangle inequality
      Activities in development

    2. Triangle Angle Relationships

      Angle sum and exterior angle theorems.

      • Use the triangle angle sum theorem
      • Use the exterior angle theorem
      • Use base angles of isosceles triangles
      Activities in development

    3. Triangle Congruence

      Prove triangles congruent with SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS and HL.

      • Choose SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS or HL
      • Prove triangles congruent
      • Use congruent triangles to find measures
      Activities in development

    4. Similar Triangles

      Prove triangles similar (AA, SAS~, SSS~) and use proportions.

      • Prove triangles similar
      • Use proportional sides to find lengths
      • Solve indirect-measurement problems
      Activities in development

    5. Pythagorean Theorem

      a² + b² = c² for right triangles, and its converse.

      • Find a missing side of a right triangle
      • Use the converse to test for right triangles
      • Solve distance and length problems
      Activities in development

    6. Special Right Triangles

      45-45-90 and 30-60-90 triangles and their side ratios.

      • Use 45-45-90 ratios
      • Use 30-60-90 ratios
      • Solve problems with special right triangles
      Activities in development
  4. Unit 4 Quadrilaterals and Polygons 5 topics

    1. Properties of Quadrilaterals

      Classify quadrilaterals and use their properties.

      • Classify quadrilaterals
      • Explain how quadrilateral types are related
      • Use properties of trapezoids and kites
      Activities in development

    2. Parallelograms

      Properties of parallelograms and ways to prove a quadrilateral is one.

      • Use sides, angles and diagonals of parallelograms
      • Prove a quadrilateral is a parallelogram
      • Check parallelograms on a coordinate grid
      Activities in development

    3. Rectangles and Rhombuses

      Special parallelograms: rectangles, rhombuses and squares.

      • Use properties of rectangles
      • Use properties of rhombuses
      • Use properties of squares
      Activities in development

    4. Regular Polygons

      Name polygons and find measures in regular polygons.

      • Name and classify polygons
      • Find angle measures in regular polygons
      • Find the area of regular polygons
      Activities in development

    5. Interior and Exterior Angles

      Polygon angle-sum theorems.

      • Use (n − 2) × 180°
      • Use the 360° exterior angle sum
      • Find the number of sides from an angle measure
      Activities in development
  5. Unit 5 Transformations 5 topics

    1. Translations

      Slide figures with vectors and coordinate rules.

      • Translate figures on a grid
      • Write translation rules
      • Describe translations with vectors
      Activities in development

    2. Reflections

      Reflect figures over lines, including the axes and y = x.

      • Reflect figures over a line
      • Use coordinate rules for reflections
      • Compose reflections
      Activities in development

    3. Rotations

      Rotate figures about a point.

      • Rotate figures about the origin
      • Use rules for 90°, 180° and 270° rotations
      • Find rotational symmetry
      Activities in development

    4. Dilations

      Enlarge or reduce figures by a scale factor from a center.

      • Dilate figures by a scale factor
      • Find a scale factor
      • Explain what dilations preserve
      Activities in development

    5. Symmetry

      Line and rotational symmetry.

      • Find lines of symmetry
      • Find the order of rotational symmetry
      • Use symmetry in design
      Activities in development
  6. Unit 6 Similarity and Scale 4 topics

    1. Scale Factors

      Use scale factors to relate similar figures and their perimeters, areas and volumes.

      • Find and use a scale factor
      • Use ratios of perimeters and areas
      • Use ratios of volumes
      Activities in development

    2. Proportional Reasoning

      Set up and solve proportions in geometric situations.

      • Set up proportions
      • Use the triangle proportionality theorem
      • Solve real-world proportion problems
      Activities in development

    3. Similar Figures

      Decide whether figures are similar and find missing measures.

      • Decide whether figures are similar
      • Find missing sides and angles
      • Describe similarity transformations
      Activities in development

    4. Scale Drawings

      Read and make scale drawings and maps.

      • Use a scale to find real lengths
      • Make a scale drawing
      • Find distances on maps
      Activities in development
  7. Unit 7 Circles 5 topics

    1. Circumference

      C = πd: the distance around a circle.

      • Find circumference from radius or diameter
      • Find radius from circumference
      • Solve rolling-distance problems
      Activities in development

    2. Area of Circles

      A = πr² and areas of sectors.

      • Find the area of a circle
      • Find the area of a sector
      • Find areas of shapes made with circles
      Activities in development

    3. Arc Length

      Find the length of part of a circle from its central angle.

      • Find arc length from a central angle in degrees
      • Find arc measures
      • Solve arc-length problems
      Activities in development

    4. Central and Inscribed Angles

      Relationships between central angles, inscribed angles and their arcs.

      • Use central angles and arcs
      • Use the inscribed angle theorem
      • Use inscribed quadrilaterals and triangles
      Activities in development

    5. Tangents and Secants

      Properties of tangent lines and angles and segments formed by secants.

      • Use tangent–radius perpendicularity
      • Use congruent tangent segments
      • Use angle and segment relationships for secants
      Activities in development
  8. Unit 8 Area and Volume 5 topics

    1. Area of Two-Dimensional Figures

      Areas of triangles, quadrilaterals and other polygons.

      • Find areas of triangles and quadrilaterals
      • Choose and apply area formulas
      • Find areas on a coordinate grid
      Activities in development

    2. Surface Area

      Surface areas of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres.

      • Find surface areas of prisms and cylinders
      • Find surface areas of pyramids and cones
      • Find surface areas of spheres
      Activities in development

    3. Volume

      Volumes of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones and spheres.

      • Find volumes of prisms and cylinders
      • Find volumes of pyramids and cones
      • Find volumes of spheres
      Activities in development

    4. Composite Figures

      Break complicated shapes and solids into simpler ones.

      • Find areas of composite figures
      • Find volumes of composite solids
      • Subtract regions to find areas and volumes
      Activities in development

    5. Three-Dimensional Geometry

      Cross-sections, nets and solids of revolution.

      • Describe cross-sections of solids
      • Match nets to solids
      • Identify solids of revolution
      Activities in development
  9. Unit 9 Coordinate Geometry 5 topics · 1 with activities

    1. Distance Formula

      d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²), the Pythagorean theorem on a grid.

      • Find the distance between two points
      • Connect the distance formula to the Pythagorean theorem
      • Find perimeters on a grid
      Activities in development

    2. Midpoint Formula

      The midpoint of a segment and finding an endpoint from a midpoint.

      • Find the midpoint of a segment
      • Find an endpoint from a midpoint
      • Use midpoints in problems
      Activities in development

    3. Slope Review

      Slope from two points, and slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines.

      • Calculate slope from two points
      • Use slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines
      • Classify figures using slope
      1 activity

    4. Equations of Lines

      Write equations of lines, including parallel and perpendicular lines.

      • Write equations in slope-intercept and point-slope form
      • Write equations of parallel and perpendicular lines
      • Find perpendicular bisectors
      Activities in development

    5. Coordinate Proofs

      Prove geometric properties with coordinates.

      • Place figures on a coordinate plane
      • Prove properties using distance, midpoint and slope
      • Classify triangles and quadrilaterals on a grid
      Activities in development
